components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; font: 600 15px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .15s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / .45) 50%, transparent 70%); translate: -120% 0; } .ds-btn:hover::before { translate: 120% 0; transition: translate .75s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #31a050); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #31a050); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #31a050) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-strong, #23803c); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-strong, #23803c) 70%, #000), 0 14px 30px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #31a050) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border, #e4ebe1); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text, #1d1e20); font: 600 15px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #31a050); color: var(--color-primary-strong, #23803c); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #31a050); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-band { padding: 24px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--color-primary, #31a050); } .ds-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--color-dark, #0d141a); font: 600 15px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #a2e187); } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site should feel like walking a dragon fruit farm in Bình Thuận at mid-morning: bright, open, green, and alive. White and pale-leaf surfaces stand in for daylight. One confident orchard green carries every action. Real photography of fields, harvesters, packing halls and stacked cartons does the persuading, because the buyer is checking that the fruit and the operation are real.

Motion is part of the identity, not garnish. Headlines flip up word by word. Cards tilt in 3D under the cursor and catch a soft glare. Glossy fruit-colored orbs drift with the pointer in the hero. Photos parallax as they scroll past, and sections rise into place as they enter. All of it switches off under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Under the liveliness, the content stays plain and factual: specs, certifications and contact channels are always one glance away.

Density is generous: wide section padding, a 1200px container, and roomy line heights tuned so Vietnamese stacked diacritics never clip.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight surfaces (white, pale leaf) with one orchard-green action color.
Real farm and packing photography in large rounded frames.
Montserrat ExtraBold headlines over Be Vietnam Pro body text.
Pill-shaped actions and chips; 12px cards; 20px photo frames.
Signature motion: word-flip headlines, 3D tilt cards with glare, drifting fruit orbs, scroll reveals, shimmer on the key headline phrase.
Soft, green-tinted ambient shadows; a dark "night field" footer closes every page.

rules.name: The One Green Voice Rule
rules.body: Every clickable call to action is Orchard Green, or white on dark bands. Lime highlights and fruit tones decorate; they never become a button.

rules.name: The Token-Only Green Rule
rules.body: The brand green changes only through `--color-primary*` / `--color-accent*` in `src/styles/global.css`. No component hard-codes a green hex.

rules.name: The Fruit-As-Garnish Rule
rules.body: Dragon Fruit Pink and Harvest Sun appear only in decorative orbs, rings and icon washes, never as text or a filled surface.

rules.name: The Diacritic Headroom Rule
rules.body: No text below 14px (`--text-xs`). Body line-height 1.7 and heading line-height of at least 1.25 are minimums, so marks like ễ, ậ and Ể never clip or touch the line above. Background-clipped text (shimmer) gets extra block padding for the same reason.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Head-Lead Rule
rules.body: Every section opens with the same trio: uppercase eyebrow with lime rule, Montserrat headline, Stem Grey lead.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Touch Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are calm at rest. Lift, tilt, glare and deeper shadow appear only in response to the pointer or scroll.

dos: Do take every color from the `--color-*` tokens in `src/styles/global.css`, and change the brand green only there.
Do build every card with the shared `Card` component on the 12px `--radius-card`.
Do open sections with eyebrow → headline → lead, and alternate Paper White and Morning Mist bands.
Do use real farm, packing and carton photography in 20px-radius frames.
Do carry the signature motion (word-flip headlines, tilt + glare cards, scroll reveals, parallax photos) onto new pages, and keep every hidden state behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do keep text at 14px or larger with the established line heights so Vietnamese diacritics have room.
Do design every string at both Vietnamese and English lengths.
donts: Don't hard-code green hex values in components or introduce a second action color.
Don't use Dragon Fruit Pink or Harvest Sun for text, buttons or filled surfaces.
Don't let one-shot reveal animations fill `forwards`/`both`; use `backwards`, or Safari paints the 3D layers blank while scrolling.
Don't set text below 14px or tighten heading line-height under 1.25.
Don't use square corners on actions; buttons, chips and tags are always pills.
